messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: How to prepare telemetry Data for processing in R-Studio
parts:
Hi Brian,

Just looking at your attachment:
First you need to go to the "Files" (by "Plots") and make sure you are in the same directory/folder as the MoveBank CSV.
Then you need to make sure you use the full file name, which should have an extension at the end like ".csv".
You can import that directly into ctmm with as.telemetry if its in MoveBank format, or import it into a data.frame via read.csv and manipulate it into MoveBank format before the as.telemetry step.
The easiest way to get your data into MoveBank format is to run your data through MoveBank, which doesn't exclude it from being privately stored. I highly recommend this.

Best,
Chris
